summary: Fitting to the R10, bounce, high-speed sync, range
specs: Off after 90 s idle; tap test button to wake

items: Fits the R10's hot shoe directly; tighten the locking collar.
Set flash compensation on the camera: **Shooting 3 › Flash control**.
The R10 won't fire any flash with the Electronic shutter mode.
This is a 2002 flash: some newer R10 flash menu options may not be available with it.

blocks.text: Hold the release button to turn the head. When bounced, coverage sets itself to 50 mm.
Reach in metres = guide number ÷ aperture. Example: 34 ÷ f/4 ≈ 8.5 m.

Flip the **FP switch** on. It only takes effect when the shutter is faster than the camera's sync speed (R10: 1/200 s mechanical, 1/250 s electronic 1st curtain). Range drops a lot; see the table above.

items: **Pilot lamp** lit = ready. Press it for a test flash.
**Green confirmation lamp** for about 3 s after a shot = enough light.
No green: move closer, open the aperture or raise ISO.
The red AF-assist beam helps focus in the dark from about 0.7 m.

blocks.text: Set the wireless selector to **SLAVE** to use it off camera. It can't trigger other flashes itself: it needs an E-TTL wireless master on the camera, such as an ST-E2 or a 550EX. Match the channel to the master. Coverage locks at 24 mm as a slave.

items: Use 4 new batteries of the same type and change all 4 together.
NiMH: about 70–80% of the flashes, but recharges about twice as fast.
In the cold, keep a spare set warm in a pocket.
Take the batteries out for long storage.
